quests.title: Ready for collection
quests.concept: Functions that return a value, and text methods
quests.summary: Gret Finch has fourteen finished orders and two collections. Put the oldest three on her board, name first and READY after, in capitals: Braum, Iona and Mira. Work payment: 20 p.
lesson: Read the order book on the board's ledge, then jack the slate in below the board.
A function can hand a result back with return. ticket("iona") then stands for whatever ticket returned.
Text has its own methods: "iona".upper() is "IONA". The order book has the names in small letters, as people signed them.
Write the ticket once as a function, then use it for each name in the list.

guide.title: Making something with a function
guide.text: return sends a value back to wherever the function was called. The caller decides what to do with it.
